units.summary: Adds a comment above the existing len(m.String()) line in Size() explaining that String() is used instead of CacheString() so Size does not mutate the receiver. The code line is unchanged, so a line-by-line review can be skipped.
units.headline: Comment added explaining Size() uses String() not CacheString()
units.reason: Only comment lines were added; the executable statement len(m.String()) is identical, so compiled behavior cannot change.

units.summary: New test checks that Size() on a Quantity built without a cached string returns a positive value and leaves q.s empty. It guards the non-mutating String() behavior and touches no production code.
units.headline: New test asserts Size() does not populate the cached string
units.reason: A new test-only addition cannot affect production behavior and its assertions match the new non-mutating String().
